title: OrganizationalUnit.Attributes
description:
Attributes that describe an organizational unit resource.

Apple Business API 2.6+

> **Note:** When additional attributes are added by Apple, they appear automatically, without requiring a newer version of the API.

createdDateTime.description: The date and time the organizational unit was created.

description.description: A description of the organizational unit.

name.description: The name of the organizational unit.

updatedDateTime.description: The date and time the organizational unit was last modified.
